page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 general purpose server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC processor clocked at 2.25 GHz, offering 8 dedicated virtual CPUs. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM allocated per core.

The instance includes no bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for persistent data and boot functionality. Hardware accelerators are omitted, with zero GPUs provisioned. For network communication, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Maintaining a standard balanced resource allocation, the ecs.u2a-c1m4.2xlarge delivers dedicated compute capacity without the overhead of specialized hardware accelerators. This configuration fits standard enterprise workloads, mid-sized databases, application backends, container orchestration nodes, and web serving environments with balanced compute and memory demands.
